# Panda - Android Screen Mirroring & Multi-Device Control

> Panda is professional-grade Android screen mirroring and multi-device control software. It enables managing, synchronizing, and automating hundreds of Android devices from a single Windows or Mac interface. Designed for developers, QA teams, and device farm operators.

## Product Overview

Panda provides a unified command center for large-scale Android device management. Key capabilities include mass device synchronization with millisecond latency, real-time visual dashboard monitoring, wired/wireless screen projection via ADB protocol, batch app management, synchronized keyboard/mouse input, smart automation with script recording, multi-user device sharing, multi-ADB parallel connections supporting up to 1,000 devices, and flexible device group management.

## Supported Platforms

- Windows 10/11
- macOS 12+
- Android 6.0+

## Key Features

1. Mass Device Sync - Millisecond latency, one-to-many control
2. Visual Dashboard - Real-time thumbnail previews, 24 FPS refresh
3. Wired/Wireless Screen Projection - USB & wireless via ADB protocol
4. App Management - Batch install/uninstall, file transfer, cache clearing
5. Keyboard & Mouse - Synchronized text templates, emoji & clipboard support
6. Smart Automation - Record/replay actions, scheduled tasks, JS/ADB scripts
7. Device Sharing - Multi-user collaborative device access
8. Multi-ADB & High-Density Projection - Up to 1,000 devices locally
9. Device Group Management - Flexible grouping for batch operations

## Pricing

- Free for the first 40 devices
- Premium subscription for additional devices
- Panda Classic has separate licensing (not interchangeable with Panda)

## Important Notes

- No root access required - based on standard Android ADB protocols
- Browser language auto-detection with user choice memory (localStorage)
- All language versions have correct hreflang tags and canonical URLs
- RTL layout support for Arabic and Hebrew
- Each page includes an H2 SEO section with localized keywords for search engine indexing
